blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Rep. Bienvenido Abante Jr. has admitted that he fell asleep during the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, but he reasoned out that it was due to her lawyers’ boring questions in their cross examination. In an interview on Monday while the Senate Impeachment Court was on a break, Abante said that he enjoys listening to arguments raised by the prosecution and the defense, but once the defense starts to bore him, he falls asleep. “Gising na ako ah,” Abante joked. “Hindi, kasi, nakaka-antok ’yong ano eh, mga tanong ng defense lawyers eh, kaya medyo nakatulog […]...
